description: Move a song the person has up or down by up to 6 semitones, keeping its speed, so it fits their voice, and play it back. Opens a small Tera Studio tool where they choose the file; the change happens in their browser and nothing is uploaded. Use it when a song is too high or too low for someone. Pass semitones if they said how far (negative is lower); otherwise they choose in the tool.

semitones.description: How far to move the song, from -6 to 6 semitones; negative is lower. Leave it out to let the person choose.

name: shift_song_key
title: Change a song’s key
